description: This file defines a servlet class named SeoCatalogUrlServlet, which handles SEO-friendly URL processing for product and category pages in an e-commerce application. It extends HttpServlet and overrides doGet and doPost methods to parse URL paths, retrieve product and category information from the database, set request attributes, and forward requests to the appropriate JSP or handler. It also provides static utility methods to build SEO-friendly URLs based on product and category IDs, incorporating breadcrumb trail management.

classes.name: SeoCatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: A servlet class responsible for parsing SEO-friendly URLs for product and category pages, retrieving relevant data, and forwarding requests accordingly.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests by parsing URL path info, retrieving product and category data, setting request attributes, and forwarding to appropriate view.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Delegates HTTP POST requests to the doGet method for processing.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl (HttpServletRequest, String, String, String)
methods.description: Constructs an SEO-friendly URL for a product or category based on current, previous, and trail category IDs within the context of an HTTP request.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl (String, List<String>, String, String, String)
methods.description: Builds an SEO URL given a context path, breadcrumb trail, product ID, current and previous category IDs.
